A '''baked potato''' is a cooked [[potato]]. It heals {{Value|Baked Potato|heals}}, more than any other ordinary simple preparation, and has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/baked_potato.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Potatoes cook into baked potatoes in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in {{Value|Baked Potato|cook_time}}. The vanilla smelting, smoking and campfire recipes are replaced. In a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]], a potato becomes a [[Charred Potato|charred potato]] instead.
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a baked potato takes {{Value|Baked Potato|eat_time}} and heals {{Value|Baked Potato|heals}}.

Obtaining a baked potato unlocks [[Pickled Potatoes|pickled potatoes]], [[latke]]s and [[Fish and Chips|fish and chips]]; it is also used in [[gnocchi]].
